verdict.rationale: Docs contain many concrete, copy-pasteable code snippets across Python/JS/Rust (e.g. lancedb-docs-19, 25, 31, 33, 34), showing example-rich reference material, but there is no evidence of an interactive, runnable API reference (no OpenAPI/Swagger spec found — lancedb-probe-2 shows all candidate OpenAPI endpoints 404) and community feedback calls the documentation confusing/poorly organized (lancedb-comm-1). missing for 10: an interactive sandbox or live-executable API explorer, an OpenAPI/reference generator, and independent confirmation that examples are actually runnable in-browser.
